environment: Use case: game-asset. Asset type: reflection environment texture for a real-time stylized glass blade material, not a picture of the blade. Generate a single seamless horizontal equirectangular panorama, approximately 2:1 aspect ratio. Full-bleed RGB texture, opaque. Neutral silver-gray overcast sky in the upper hemisphere with broad irregular soft cloud openings, one asymmetric luminous overcast opening upper-left, darker slate-gray distant tree silhouettes and charcoal ground in the lower hemisphere, a very restrained warm reflected opening at the far right. Sophisticated high-contrast but un-clipped lighting, readable broad light masses at 256px, soft edges and rich quiet midtones, suitable for direction-dependent specular reflections on low-roughness transparent glass. Left and right panorama edges should meet naturally. No sword, no other foreground objects, no inset previews, no grid, no labels, no lettering, no watermark, no frame, no painted glowing lines or lens flares. This map supplies lighting/reflection only; retain essentially neutral color so individual weapon colors come from the shader.
height: Use case: game-asset. Asset type: grayscale surface-height source texture for a polished flowing glass blade, to be converted mathematically into a normal map and a roughness map. Generate one square, full-bleed seamless tile, opaque grayscale RGB, no alpha. Mid-gray approximately 128 baseline, shallow smooth irregular long drawn-glass striations flowing predominantly horizontally. Very subtle broad waviness and a few fine branching annealed-glass flow bands; continuous, organically uneven distribution. Calm polished surface, not molten lava, no aggressive cracks, no holes, no damage, no glitter, no perspective, no scene. It should look like a neutral scalar height map rather than a photograph: no directional illumination, no baked shadows, no white specular highlights, no glowing outlines. Keep most values within middle grays and avoid pure black and pure white; gradients should be smooth. Features should be sparse and broad enough to remain legible when sampled on a 30-pixel-wide game effect, not dense micro-noise. Seamless in both directions. No text, no captions, no grid, no borders, no contact sheet, no watermark.
